def transform(grid):
    # Divide input into 4x4 cells separated by grid color. First column gives colors;
    # pattern in upper middle cell is stamped in each cell of rows by row marker color.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # separator color from intersection
    sep=grid[4][0]
    # cell origins every 5
    n=(h+1)//5
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for br in range(n):
        for bc in range(n):
            r0,c0=br*5,bc*5
            if r0+4>=h or c0+4>=w: continue
            # marker color in first column cell at local (1,1)
            color=grid[r0+1][c0+1]
            if color==0 or color==sep: continue
            # central pattern at block row 1, block col 2 (where shape occupies), bounding cell local 4x4
            # infer template from nonzero color pixels, replace with current marker
            if br==1 and bc==2:
                template=[[(grid[r0+i][c0+j]!=0 and grid[r0+i][c0+j]!=sep) for j in range(4)] for i in range(4)]
            else:
                template=None
    # locate shape explicitly: find cell with most nonzero excluding marker tiles and separators
    candidates=[]
    for br in range(n):
      for bc in range(n):
        r0,c0=br*5,bc*5
        if r0+3>=h or c0+3>=w: continue
        vals=[grid[r0+i][c0+j] for i in range(4) for j in range(4)]
        if sum(v not in (0,sep) for v in vals)>4 and not (bc==0 and sum(v not in (0,sep) for v in vals)==4):
          candidates.append((sum(v not in (0,sep) for v in vals),r0,c0,vals))
    _,sr,sc,vals=max(candidates)
    template=[[grid[sr+i][sc+j] not in (0,sep) for j in range(4)] for i in range(4)]
    for br in range(n):
      for bc in range(n):
        r0,c0=br*5,bc*5
        if r0+3>=h or c0+3>=w: continue
        # each row of cells takes its key color from first cell; overwrite all interior cell backgrounds
        color=grid[r0+1][1]
        if color in (0,sep): continue
        for i in range(4):
          for j in range(4): out[r0+i][c0+j]=color if template[i][j] else 0
    # retain separators
    return out
